<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Spark! Children's Science Museum</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Hands-on science for curious kids ages 2 to 12. Build, explore, and discover at Spark! Children's Science Museum.">
  <style>
    :root {
      --navy: #1b2a4a;
      --navy-2: #24386a;
      --sun: #ffc23d;
      --coral: #ff6b5b;
      --teal: #1fb5a8;
      --mint: #c9f4e8;
      --sky: #7cc6fe;
      --lilac: #b7a6ff;
      --cream: #fff9ef;
      --ink: #1d2433;
      --muted: #5b6478;
      --radius: 22px;
      --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(27, 42, 74, 0.12);
      --font-display: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
      --font-body: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    }

    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      color: var(--ink);
      background: var(--cream);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    h1, h2, h3 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin: 0 0 0.5em;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    p { margin: 0 0 1em; }

    a { color: inherit; }

    img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }

    .container {
      width: min(1160px, 92%);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .section {
      padding: clamp(60px, 8vw, 110px) 0;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-block;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--coral);
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    .section-head {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 680px;
      margin: 0 auto clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px);
    }

    .section-head h2 {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
    }

    .section-head p {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
    }

    /* Buttons */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.9rem 1.6rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      text-decoration: none;
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
      font-family: inherit;
    }

    .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .btn:focus-visible,
    a:focus-visible,
    input:focus-visible,
    button:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid var(--sky);
      outline-offset: 3px;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--sun);
      color: var(--navy);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(255, 194, 61, 0.45);
    }
    .btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(255, 194, 61, 0.55); }

    .btn-ghost {
      background: transparent;
      color: #fff;
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    }
    .btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

    .btn-navy {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: #fff;
    }
    .btn-navy:hover { background: var(--navy-2); }

    /* Header */
    .site-header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 50;
      background: rgba(27, 42, 74, 0.96);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 76px;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .logo-text span { color: var(--sun); }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.8rem;
      list-style: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--sun); }

    .nav-cta {
      padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      background: var(--sun);
      color: var(--navy) !important;
      border-radius: 999px;
    }

    .menu-toggle {
      display: none;
      background: none;
      border: 0;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 1.8rem;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, rgba(124,198,254,0.35), transparent 40%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 85% 30%, rgba(255,107,91,0.35), transparent 40%),
        linear-gradient(160deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-2) 100%);
      color: #fff;
      padding: clamp(70px, 10vw, 130px) 0 clamp(80px, 10vw, 140px);
    }

    .hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
      gap: clamp(30px, 5vw, 70px);
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      color: #fff;
      font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 4.4rem);
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      margin-bottom: 0.4em;
    }

    .hero h1 .highlight {
      color: var(--sun);
      position: relative;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .hero-sub {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      max-width: 540px;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .hero-note {
      margin-top: 1.5rem;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    }

    .hero-art {
      position: relative;
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 480px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .orbit {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 40s linear infinite;
    }

    .orbit.two { inset: 12%; animation-duration: 25s; animation-direction: reverse; }

    .planet {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      box-shadow: inset -18px -12px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
    }

    .planet.sun-core {
      width: 40%;
      height: 40%;
      top: 30%;
      left: 30%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #fff3b0, var(--sun) 60%, #ff9a3c);
      box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(255,194,61,0.6);
      animation: pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .planet.p1 {
      width: 16%; height: 16%;
      top: 4%; left: 42%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #bff3ea, var(--teal));
      animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .planet.p2 {
      width: 11%; height: 11%;
      bottom: 14%; right: 12%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #ffd0c9, var(--coral));
      animation: float 7s ease-in-out infinite reverse;
    }

    .planet.p3 {
      width: 8%; height: 8%;
      top: 48%; left: 4%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #e3dbff, var(--lilac));
      animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 4%;
      left: 0;
      background: #fff;
      color: var(--ink);
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.7rem;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .hero-badge strong { display: block; color: var(--navy); font-size: 1rem; }

    .wave {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -1px;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 70px;
      display: block;
    }

    /* Stats strip */
    .stats {
      background: var(--cream);
      padding: 0;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      margin-top: -20px;
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 1rem;
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      padding: 1.6rem;
    }

    .stat {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0.4rem;
    }

    .stat-number {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.4rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--teal);
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .stat-label {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      margin-top: 0.35rem;
    }

    /* Exhibits */
    .exhibits-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.6rem;
    }

    .exhibit {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 2rem 1.7rem 1.8rem;
      color: var(--navy);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      min-height: 280px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .exhibit:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px) rotate(-0.4deg);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(27,42,74,0.18);
    }

    .exhibit .icon {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
    }

    .exhibit h3 {
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .exhibit p {
      font-size: 0.98rem;
      color: rgba(27,42,74,0.82);
      margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
    }

    .tag {
      margin-top: auto;
      align-self: flex-start;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.85rem;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .ex-sun    { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffe38a, #ffc23d); }
    .ex-teal   { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a8f0e3, #1fb5a8); color: #0c2b28; }
    .ex-teal p { color: rgba(12,43,40,0.85); }
    .ex-coral  { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffc1b8, #ff6b5b); }
    .ex-sky    { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #cfe9ff, #7cc6fe); }
    .ex-lilac  { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e3dbff, #b7a6ff); }
    .ex-mint   { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e6fbf4, #c9f4e8); }

    /* Lab / interactive */
    .lab {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: #fff;
      border-radius: 32px;
      padding: clamp(36px, 6vw, 70px);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: clamp(30px, 5vw, 60px);
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .lab::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 320px; height: 320px;
      right: -120px; top: -120px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(31,181,168,0.45), transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .lab h2 { color: #fff; font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.8rem); }
    .lab p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }

    .lab-list {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 1.5rem 0 0;
    }

    .lab-list li {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.8rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
    }

    .lab-list li::before {
      content: "✦";
      color: var(--sun);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .fact-card {
      background: #fff;
      color: var(--ink);
      border-radius: 26px;
      padding: 2rem;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .fact-card .label {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--coral);
    }

    .fact-text {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      min-height: 5.5em;
      margin: 0.7rem 0 1.2rem;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    }

    .fact-text.fade { opacity: 0; }

    .fact-controls {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .btn-small {
      padding: 0.6rem 1.1rem;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
    }

    .btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      border-color: var(--navy);
      color: var(--navy);
    }
    .btn-outline:hover { background: var(--navy); color: #fff; }

    /* Events */
    .events-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.4rem;
    }

    .event {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 84px 1fr;
      gap: 1.2rem;
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 1.2rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      align-items: center;
    }

    .event-date {
      background: var(--mint);
      border-radius: 18px;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0.8rem 0.4rem;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .event-date .month {
      display: block;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--teal);
    }

    .event-date .day {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 2.1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .event h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
    .event p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--muted); }

    /* Tickets */
    .tickets-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.6rem;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .ticket {
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 2.2rem 2rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      position: relative;
    }

    .ticket.featured {
      border-color: var(--teal);
      transform: translateY(-10px);
    }

    .ticket .badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: -14px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: var(--coral);
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      padding: 0.35rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .ticket h3 { font-size: 1.4rem; }

    .price {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 3rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      line-height: 1;
      margin: 0.8rem 0 0.2rem;
    }

    .price small {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .ticket .desc {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
    }

    .ticket ul {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0 0 1.8rem;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .ticket li {
      padding: 0.45rem 0;
      border-bottom: 1px dashed #e4e8f0;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
    }

    .ticket li::before {
      content: "✓ ";
      color: var(--teal);
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .ticket .btn { width: 100%; }

    /* Visit */
    .visit-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: clamp(30px, 5vw, 60px);
      align-items: start;
    }

    .hours-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .hours-table th,
    .hours-table td {
      padding: 0.95rem 1.3rem;
      text-align: left;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #eef1f6;
    }

    .hours-table th { color: var(--navy); font-family: var(--font-display); }
    .hours-table td { color: var(--muted); text-align: right; }
    .hours-table tr:last-child th,
    .hours-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }

    .hours-table tr.closed td { color: var(--coral); font-weight: 700; }

    .info-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-top: 1.6rem;
    }

    .info-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: flex-start;
      background: #fff;
      padding: 1.1rem 1.3rem;
      border-radius: 18px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .info-item .emoji {
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .info-item strong { display: block; color: var(--navy); }
    .info-item span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.95rem; }

    .map-card {
      background:
        linear-gradient(rgba(124,198,254,0.15) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 28px 28px,
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(124,198,254,0.15) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 28px 28px,
        var(--mint);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      min-height: 420px;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .map-road {
      position: absolute;
      background: #fff;
      opacity: 0.9;
    }
    .map-road.h { height: 26px; left: 0; right: 0; top: 55%; transform: rotate(-6deg); }
    .map-road.v { width: 26px; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 38%; transform: rotate(8deg); }

    .map-park {
      position: absolute;
      width: 130px; height: 90px;
      left: 10%; top: 12%;
      background: #9be3a6;
      border-radius: 18px;
    }

    .map-pin {
      position: absolute;
      left: 56%;
      top: 36%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -100%);
      text-align: center;
      animation: bounce 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .map-pin .dot {
      width: 46px; height: 46px;
      background: var(--coral);
      border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 0;
      transform: rotate(-45deg);
      border: 4px solid #fff;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .map-label {
      margin-top: 0.4rem;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: #fff;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .map-card .btn {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 20px;
      left: 20px;
    }

    /* Testimonials */
    .quotes-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.6rem;
    }

    .quote {
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 2rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      position: relative;
    }

    .quote::before {
      content: "“";
      position: absolute;
      top: 6px;
      right: 22px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 5rem;
      line-height: 1;
      color: var(--sky);
      opacity: 0.6;
    }

    .quote p {
      font-size: 1.02rem;
      color: var(--ink);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .quote-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.8rem;
      margin-top: 1.2rem;
    }

    .avatar {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
    }

    .quote-author strong { display: block; color: var(--navy); font-size: 0.98rem; }
    .quote-author span { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--muted); }

    /* Newsletter */
    .signup {
      background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--teal), var(--sky));
      border-radius: 32px;
      padding: clamp(36px, 6vw, 64px);
      color: #fff;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .signup h2 { color: #fff; }
    .signup p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto 1.8rem; }

    .signup-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .signup-form input {
      flex: 1 1 260px;
      padding: 0.95rem 1.2rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      font: inherit;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .signup-form .btn-navy { flex: 0 0 auto; }

    .form-msg {
      margin-top: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      min-height: 1.4em;
    }

    /* Footer */
    .site-footer {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
      padding: 70px 0 30px;
      margin-top: 40px;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 2.5rem;
    }

    .site-footer h4 {
      color: #fff;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .site-footer ul {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .site-footer li { margin-bottom: 0.55rem; }

    .site-footer a {
      text-decoration: none;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
    }
    .site-footer a:hover { color: var(--sun); }

    .footer-bottom {
      margin-top: 50px;
      padding-top: 24px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    /* Animations */
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    @keyframes float {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-14px); }
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
      50% { transform: scale(1.05); }
    }
    @keyframes bounce {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -100%); }
      50% { transform: translate(-50%, -115%); }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation: none !important;
        transition: none !important;
        scroll-behavior: auto !important;
      }
    }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 960px) {
      .hero-grid,
      .lab,
      .visit-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

      .hero-art { max-width: 380px; margin-top: 20px; }

      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .tickets-grid,
      .quotes-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto; }

      .ticket.featured { transform: none; }

      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 760px) {
      .menu-toggle { display: block; }

      .nav-links {
        position: absolute;
        top: 76px;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;

      .hero-art .planet { position: absolute; }
      .hero-actions .btn { flex: 1 1 100%; }
    }
  </style>

  <script>
    // Mobile nav toggle
    const toggle = document.querySelector('.menu-toggle');
    const navLinks = document.getElementById('nav-links');

    toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = navLinks.classList.toggle('open');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isOpen));
    });

    navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        navLinks.classList.remove('open');
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
    });

    // Fun facts
    const facts = [
      "Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.",
      "Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.",
      "A bolt of lightning is about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.",
      "Honey never spoils. Archaeologists have found edible honey in ancient Egyptian tombs.",
      "Your nose can remember around 50,000 different smells.",
      "A day on Venus is longer than its year.",
      "Hummingbirds are the only birds that can fly backwards.",
      "Sound travels about four times faster in water than in air.",
      "Your bones are about five times stronger than steel of the same weight.",
      "Peanuts are used to make dynamite, and also to make it safer to handle."
    ];

    const factText = document.getElementById('fact-text');
    const factCount = document.getElementById('fact-count');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('next-fact');
    let factIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * facts.length);
    let seen = 0;

    function showFact() {
      factText.classList.add('fade');
      setTimeout(() => {
        factIndex = (factIndex + 1) % facts.length;
        factText.textContent = facts[factIndex];
        factText.classList.remove('fade');
        seen++;
        factCount.textContent = `${seen} fact${seen === 1 ? '' : 's'} discovered`;
      }, 300);
    }

    factText.textContent = facts[factIndex];
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', showFact);

    // Newsletter form
    const form = document.getElementById('signup-form');
    const msg = document.getElementById('form-msg');

    form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
      const valid = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email);

      if (!valid) {
        msg.style.color = '#ffe38a';
        msg.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
        return;
      }

      msg.style.color = '#fff';
      msg.textContent = 'Welcome to the lab! Check your inbox for a surprise.';
      form.reset();
    });
  </script>
